newsitem.title: ITALY: PRESS DIGEST - ITALY - FRIDAY AUGUST 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - ITALY - FRIDAY AUGUST 8.

text.p: The following are some of the top headlines in leading Italian newspapers.

* Italy's largest trade union CGIL said in a report that there are currently more pensions drawn for the over 75s than pensioners in that age bracket. Some eight trillion lire is currently paid out to Italians who have already died, CGIL estimated. (all)

* Prosecutors are continuing investigations into accusations that former anti-Mafia police chief General Giovanni Verdicchio received kickbacks from businessmen. He is part of a probe into some 30 people accused of corruption. (all)
* Italy's all-share Mibtel stock market index stopped climbing after the dollar ended its upward spiral. (all)
* Less tourists are chosing Italy's Riviera and the Italian Alps as holiday destinations this year. Many hoteliers say their rooms are not full (all).
Reuters has not verified these stories and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
